evidence: Technology and AI are transforming the foodservice industry, driving efficiency and deeper customer engagement. AI-powered tools such as self-ordering kiosks, predictive scheduling, kitchen robotics and real-time inventory systems reduce waste, optimize labor and improve profitability.

We previously have and plan to continue to incorporate AI, including machine learning, into certain of our operations, such as sales, support and supply chain, and may in the future incorporate AI into more of our operations.
These innovations enable predictive maintenance, optimized logistics and data-driven menu design, while enhancing customer experiences through chatbots, voice assistants and biometric recognition.
ai_positioning.summary: USFD intègre l'IA dans ses opérations internes (ventes, support, supply chain) et reconnaît son rôle transformateur dans l'industrie foodservice, tout en gérant les risques associés à son déploiement.
